longDescriptions: Program a variety of garage door openers

features.name: Lane Departure Warning
longDescriptions: This tech provides an audible/visual warning if it detects an inadvertent lane departure. Typically this can be turned off within driver controls or the instrument display.
Lane departure warning systems are dependent on many factors, including: road, weather, and vehicle conditions.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating lane departure warning. A car is driving and starts to veer out of the lane. An alert is provided to the driver and the driver moves the car away from the lane markers.

features.name: Blind Spot Monitor
longDescriptions: This tech uses sensors to detect vehicles in the adjacent lane. If the blind spot monitor system detects a vehicle, the system will provide you with a visual and/or audible alert. Typically this can be turned off within driver controls or the instrument display.
Blind spot monitor systems are meant to assist you and should not be relied upon exclusively.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating blind spot monitoring while driving on a multi lane highway. A vehicle approaches and passes another vehicle. While the vehicle is in the blind spot, the driver is alerted.

features.name: Rear View Camera
longDescriptions: A view to help avoid blindspots.

media.ariaLabel: A picture of the back up camera available on this vehicle.

features.name: Parking Sensors
longDescriptions: This tech provides an audible/visual warning when objects are dangerously close to the path of the car while parking in reverse. For some cars, the alert will get louder the closer you get to the object. Typically this can be turned off within driver controls or the instrument display.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating parking sensors. A car is entering a parking spot in reverse and an alert appears when the car is getting dangerously close to the object behind it.

features.name: Cross-Traffic Alert
longDescriptions: Alerts you if a vehicle is approaching from the sides while in reverse
Rear cross traffic alert systems are built to assist you and should not be relied upon exclusively.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating rear cross traffic alert technology. A car is backing out of a parking space when cross traffic approaches. The car alerts the driver of oncoming cross traffic and the driver stops backing up.

features.name: Navigation System
longDescriptions: GPS to get you where you're going.

media.ariaLabel: A picture of the navigation system available on this vehicle.

features.name: Apple CarPlay®
longDescriptions: Apple CarPlay® brings phone, maps, messages, music, and other popular apps to the car’s touchscreen dashboard display and makes them accessible via Siri voice commands.
To use, simply connect your iOS device via the USB port in the center console. Apps that use the internet will consume data from your iOS device and data charges may apply.
features.disclaimer: Apple CarPlay is a registered trademark of Apple Inc. and its use here does not imply affiliation with or endorsement by Apple Inc. Screen capture shown is not of actual car.

media.ariaLabel: A series of screen shots of how the car display looks while using Apple CarPlay. Two screenshots show the app overview screens, one Apple Maps, and one a split screen view that shows maps, music, and location information.

features.name: Android Auto™
longDescriptions: Android Auto™ brings phone, maps, messages, music, and other popular apps to the car’s touchscreen dashboard display and makes them accessible via Google Assistant.
To use, simply connect your Android device via the USB port in the center console. Apps that use the internet will consume data from your device and data charges may apply.

data.reviewSummary: The 2019 Cadillac XT4 delivers smooth handling, impressive power from its turbocharged 4-cylinder engine, and a luxurious interior with advanced technology. Positive feedback praises comfort and style, though fuel economy and occasional tech issues are mentioned. Some buyers express concerns about reliability and high maintenance costs.

features.name: Lane Departure Warning
longDescriptions: This tech provides an audible/visual warning if it detects an inadvertent lane departure. Typically this can be turned off within driver controls or the instrument display.
Lane departure warning systems are dependent on many factors, including: road, weather, and vehicle conditions.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating lane departure warning. A car is driving and starts to veer out of the lane. An alert is provided to the driver and the driver moves the car away from the lane markers.

features.name: Blind Spot Monitor
longDescriptions: This tech uses sensors to detect vehicles in the adjacent lane. If the blind spot monitor system detects a vehicle, the system will provide you with a visual and/or audible alert. Typically this can be turned off within driver controls or the instrument display.
Blind spot monitor systems are meant to assist you and should not be relied upon exclusively.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating blind spot monitoring while driving on a multi lane highway. A vehicle approaches and passes another vehicle. While the vehicle is in the blind spot, the driver is alerted.

features.name: Rear View Camera
longDescriptions: A view to help avoid blindspots.

media.ariaLabel: A picture of the back up camera available on this vehicle.

features.name: Parking Sensors
longDescriptions: This tech provides an audible/visual warning when objects are dangerously close to the path of the car while parking in reverse. For some cars, the alert will get louder the closer you get to the object. Typically this can be turned off within driver controls or the instrument display.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating parking sensors. A car is entering a parking spot in reverse and an alert appears when the car is getting dangerously close to the object behind it.

features.name: Cross-Traffic Alert
longDescriptions: Alerts you if a vehicle is approaching from the sides while in reverse
Rear cross traffic alert systems are built to assist you and should not be relied upon exclusively.

media.ariaLabel: An animation demonstrating rear cross traffic alert technology. A car is backing out of a parking space when cross traffic approaches. The car alerts the driver of oncoming cross traffic and the driver stops backing up.

features.name: Navigation System
longDescriptions: GPS to get you where you're going.

media.ariaLabel: A picture of the navigation system available on this vehicle.

features.name: Apple CarPlay®
longDescriptions: Apple CarPlay® brings phone, maps, messages, music, and other popular apps to the car’s touchscreen dashboard display and makes them accessible via Siri voice commands.
To use, simply connect your iOS device via the USB port in the center console. Apps that use the internet will consume data from your iOS device and data charges may apply.
